verses.text: The DOMNUL a vorbit lui Moise, Go in to Faraon, and tell him, ‘This is what the DOMNUL says, Let poporul Meu să plece, that they may serve me.
If you refuse to let them să plece, behold, I will plague all your borders with frogs.

The river will swarm with frogs, which will să plece up and come into your house, and into your bedroom, and on your bed, and into the house of your servants, and on your people, and into your ovens, and into your kneading troughs.
The frogs shall come up both on you, and on your people, and on all your servants. ’  (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
The DOMNUL i-a zis lui Moise, Tell Aaron, ‘Stretch out your mână with your rod over the rivers, over the streams, and over the pools, and cause frogs to come up on the țară of Egipt.’
Aaron stretched out his mână over the waters of Egipt; and the frogs came up, and covered the țară of Egipt.
The magicians did the same thing with their enchantments, and brought up frogs on the țară of Egipt.

Then Faraon called for Moise and Aaron, and a zis, Entreat the DOMNUL, that he take away the frogs from me and from poporul Meu; and I will let the people să plece, that they may sacrifice to the DOMNUL.

Moise i-a zis lui Faraon, I give you the honor of setting the time that I should pray for you, and for your servants, and for your people, that the frogs be destroyed from you and your houses, and remain in the river only. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
Faraon a zis, Tomorrow. Moise a zis, Let it be according to your word, that you may know that there is no one like the DOMNUL our Dumnezeu. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
The frogs shall depart from you, and from your houses, and from your servants, and from your people. They shall remain in the river only. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
Moise and Aaron went out from Faraon, and Moise cried to the DOMNUL concerning the frogs which he had brought on Faraon. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
The DOMNUL did according to the word of Moise, and the frogs died out of the houses, out of the courts, and out of the fields. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
They gathered them together in heaps, and the țară stank.
But when Faraon saw that there was a respite, he hardened his heart, and didn’t listen to them, as the DOMNUL had spoken. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
The DOMNUL i-a zis lui Moise, Tell Aaron, ‘Stretch out your rod, and strike the dust of the earth, that it may become lice throughout all the țară of Egipt.’

They did so; and Aaron stretched out his mână with his rod, and struck the dust of the earth, and there were lice on man, and on animal; all the dust of the earth became lice throughout all the țară of Egipt.
The magicians tried with their enchantments to produce lice, but they couldn’t. There were lice on man, and on animal. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)

Then the magicians i-a zis lui Faraon, This is Dumnezeu’s finger; but Faraon’s heart was hardened, and he didn’t listen to them, as the DOMNUL had spoken. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)

The DOMNUL i-a zis lui Moise, Rise up early in the morning, and stand before Faraon; behold, he comes out to the water; and tell him, ‘This is what the DOMNUL says, Let poporul Meu să plece, that they may serve me.

Else, if you will not let poporul Meu să plece, behold, I will send swarms of flies on you, and on your servants, and on your people, and into your houses. The houses of the Egiptians shall be full of swarms of flies, and also the ground they are on.
I will set apart in that day the țară of Goshen, in which poporul Meu dwell, that no swarms of flies shall be there, to the end you may know that Eu sunt the DOMNUL on the earth.
I will put a division between poporul Meu and your people. This sign shall happen by tomorrow. ’  (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
The DOMNUL did so; and there came grievous swarms of flies into the house of Faraon, and into his servants’ houses. In all the țară of Egipt the țară was corrupted by reason of the swarms of flies.
Faraon called for Moise and for Aaron, and a zis, Go, sacrifice to your Dumnezeu in the țară!

Moise a zis, It isn’t appropriate to do so; for we shall sacrifice the abomination of the Egiptians to the DOMNUL our Dumnezeu. Behold, if we sacrifice the abomination of the Egiptians before their eyes, won’t they stone us? (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
We will să plece three days’ journey into the wilderness, and sacrifice to the DOMNUL our Dumnezeu, as he shall command us.
Faraon a zis, I will let you să plece, that you may sacrifice to the DOMNUL your Dumnezeu in the wilderness, only you shall not să plece very far away. Pray for me.

Moise a zis, Behold, Eu sunt să pleceing out from you. I will pray to the DOMNUL that the swarms of flies may depart from Faraon, from his servants, and from his people, tomorrow; only don’t let Faraon deal deceitfully any more in not letting the people să plece to sacrifice to the DOMNUL.
Moise went out from Faraon, and prayed to the DOMNUL. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)

The DOMNUL did according to the word of Moise, and he removed the swarms of flies from Faraon, from his servants, and from his people. There remained not one. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
Faraon hardened his heart this time also, and he didn’t let the people să plece.
